title: Shared Tickets and Cases plugins
summary: Tickets and Cases now live as shared first-party plugins that any enabled organisation module can host, without changing live URLs or permission names.
changes: Moved Tickets into plugins/tickets with one ModuleContext-driven controller and view set for APES CIC, Shelter, and Pet Care Clinic.
Moved Cases into plugins/cases with one controller set for APES CIC and Shelter; rows still use the shelter_cases table.
Shelter Cases continue to depend on the Pet Profiles plugin API for pet pickers and visibility.
Preserved live ticket and case URLs and permission strings; morph aliases and notification stubs keep existing records rendering.
affected_areas: Tickets plugin package and staff ticket routes under /apes-cic, /shelter, and /petcare
Cases plugin package and staff case routes under /apes-cic and /shelter
Morph map aliases for support tickets and cases
Admin Plugins manifests for Tickets and Cases
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.37.x Structure line: relocates existing Tickets and Cases features into plugin packages without new public capability or breaking URL/permission changes.
validation: Focused PHPUnit: StructureTicketsCasesWave6Test plus ticket/case workflow and morph/contracts suites
known_limitations: Recruitment and Consultations remain for a later Structure wave.
Architecture hard-fail tests still report-only until Wave 8.
Historical audit event key names are unchanged; new events continue to use the existing area prefixes.
rollback: Redeploy the previous Cloudron package (0.37.8). No database rename was introduced; plugin namespaces resolve via morph aliases and notification stubs.
provenance: Issue #289, pull request #309, branch bmurphy/wave6-tickets-cases-f73f (Structure Wave 6 after live 0.37.8).
